subjects: rates curve trade: pay 5s30s at 62bp and the 4.40% level holding on a close
mis_merges.why: The JPM 5s30s and Citi 4.40% cards are a rates/curve story with no oil content, so bundling them under 'Oil' would cause an editor to either miscast a rates theme as an oil theme or drop it entirely instead of selecting it as its own theme.

notes: AI capex cycle and hyperscaler spending acceleration are one subject split by wording. Oil mis-merges a genuine Hormuz/Brent card with two unrelated rates cards, which alone would change theme selection.
